description: Book an air or ocean option from international_quote. Requires the option_id the user chose, full pickup and delivery addresses with contact name and phone, and the same items that were quoted. For door_to_port and port_to_door options, set port_charges_acknowledged only after the user has accepted that charges at the far port are extra. Customs data can be sent now in international_info or added later with international_customs. An international booking cannot be cancelled through the API, so only call after the user explicitly confirms this option and price. Payment follows the account (terms, balance or card); if a payment_link comes back, the order is held until the user pays there. Auth required.

international_info.description: Optional customs data in gw's internationalInfo shape (incoterm, shipper, consignee, commodities, ...)

quantity.description: Number of identical pallets / pieces in this line

stackable.description: Whether units can be stacked. Defaults to false.

option_id.description: option_id the user chose, from your MOST RECENT international_quote

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code; must match the quote

phone.description: Contact phone with country code, e.g. +862150000000

window.description: Time window as ISO 8601 UTC timestamps

zipcode.description: Postal code; must match the quote

port_charges_acknowledged.description: true once the user accepts far-port charges (door_to_port / port_to_door only)

name: international_book
title: Book International (Air / Ocean)
